description: This Java source file defines the PersonQuery class, which provides various search query methods for retrieving Person objects based on name attributes, attributes, and other filters within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It contains methods for constructing complex Lucene-based search predicates utilizing Hibernate Search.

classes.name: PersonQuery
classes.description: Provides methods for constructing search predicates to query Person records based on name, attributes, and other criteria using Hibernate Search and Lucene query syntax.

methods.name: getPatientNameQuery
methods.description: Creates a search predicate for a patient's name, including options for inclusion of voided records.

methods.name: getPersonNameQueryWithOrParser
methods.description: Creates a name-based search predicate with an OR query parser configuration, inclusive of voided records.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnThreeNames
methods.description: Generates a search predicate based on soundex matching across three name components, including optional filters such as birth year, gender, and voided status.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnTwoNames
methods.description: Constructs a soundex-based search predicate involving two name components with filtering options.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnNNames
methods.description: Creates a search predicate that performs soundex matching across multiple name components provided as an array.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameQuery
methods.description: General method for building a soundex search predicate on various name attributes with filters.

methods.name: getPersonNameQuery
methods.description: Constructs a predicate for searching persons by name with match mode based on global properties.

methods.name: newPersonNameSearchQuery
methods.description: Helper method to construct detailed name search predicates with specified search fields and filtering.

methods.name: applyPersonFilters
methods.description: Applies filters such as voided status, patient status, dead status, gender, and birth year to a predicate builder object.

methods.name: getPatientAttributeQuery
methods.description: Creates a search predicate for person attributes, including options for including voided records.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeQueryWithOrParser
methods.description: Constructs a person attribute search predicate with OR query parser options and filtering.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeQuery
methods.description: Builds a predicate for searching person attributes with filtering options for voided status and match modes.
